Labels.org.opencontainers.image.base.name: ubuntu:24.04
Labels.org.opencontainers.image.description: Private FastAPI worker: Pythia-160M + probe pipeline, SSE trace stream, behind the noetic-compass-api proxy.
Labels.org.opencontainers.image.title: atlas-live-trace-worker

Test: python -c "import os,urllib.request,sys;   url='http://127.0.0.1:%s/health' % os.environ.get('PORT','8080');   sys.exit(0 if urllib.request.urlopen(url, timeout=4).status==200 else 1)" || exit 1

history.created_by: LABEL org.opencontainers.image.title=atlas-live-trace-worker org.opencontainers.image.description=Private FastAPI worker: Pythia-160M + probe pipeline, SSE trace stream, behind the noetic-compass-api proxy. org.opencontainers.image.source=https://github.com/LittleHenderson/noetic-compass org.opencontainers.image.base.name=ubuntu:24.04 org.opencontainers.image.base.digest=sha256:019e8eb29a85e74d64925745884f2ec79aa27e3feab36353d24656f4d6b89467 org.opencontainers.image.python.digest=sha256:6e13e65c55e33adf203d77ee371cf8bf5d81bd4902ef07565721f46bf44917af org.opencontainers.image.ubuntu.snapshot=20260805T000000Z org.opencontainers.image.run.readonly-rootfs=required org.opencontainers.image.run.tmpfs=/tmp:rw,noexec,nosuid,nodev,size=64m org.opencontainers.image.run.auth=ATLAS_LIVE_WORKER_TOKEN required

RUN /bin/sh -c sed -i       's|http://archive.ubuntu.com/ubuntu/|https://snapshot.ubuntu.com/ubuntu/20260805T000000Z/|; s|http://security.ubuntu.com/ubuntu/|https://snapshot.ubuntu.com/ubuntu/20260805T000000Z/|'       /etc/apt/sources.list.d/ubuntu.sources     && apt-get update     && DEBIAN_FRONTEND=noninteractive apt-get install -y --no-install-recommends       ca-certificates=20260601~24.04.1       libreadline8t64=8.2-4build1       libsqlite3-0=3.45.1-1ubuntu2.7       netbase=6.4       tzdata=2026c-0ubuntu0.24.04.1     && rm -rf /var/lib/apt/lists/* # buildkit

RUN /bin/sh -c rm -f       /usr/local/lib/python3.12/lib-dynload/_gdbm*.so       /usr/local/lib/python3.12/lib-dynload/_tkinter*.so       /usr/local/lib/python3.12/lib-dynload/nis*.so     && missing="$(find /usr/local/lib/python3.12/lib-dynload -type f -name '*.so'       -exec ldd '{}' \; 2>/dev/null | grep 'not found' || true)"     && test -z "$missing"     && python -c "import bz2,ctypes,lzma,readline,sqlite3,ssl" # buildkit

ENV HF_HOME=/worker/.cache/huggingface PYTHIA_160M_REVISION=50f5173d932e8e61f858120bcb800b97af589f46 ATLAS_WORKER_PROFILE=production ATLAS_WORKER_REQUIRE_READ_ONLY_ROOTFS=1 NVIDIA_VISIBLE_DEVICES=all NVIDIA_DRIVER_CAPABILITIES=compute,utility PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1 PYTHONUNBUFFERED=1 PORT=8080
RUN /bin/sh -c python -m pip install --no-cache-dir --require-hashes       --only-binary=:all: --no-deps -r requirements.txt     && python -m pip check # buildkit

RUN /bin/sh -c python -m pip uninstall --yes pip     && rm -rf /usr/local/lib/python3.12/ensurepip     && test ! -e /usr/local/bin/pip     && test ! -e /usr/local/bin/pip3     && python -c "import importlib.util; assert importlib.util.find_spec('ensurepip') is None" # buildkit
RUN /bin/sh -c groupadd --gid 10001 atlas-worker     && useradd --uid 10001 --gid 10001 --no-create-home       --shell /usr/sbin/nologin atlas-worker # buildkit
RUN /bin/sh -c chown -R 0:0 /worker     && find /worker -type d -exec chmod 0555 '{}' +     && find /worker -type f -exec chmod 0444 '{}' + # buildkit
RUN |1 SOURCE_COMMIT=4bff437dbcf6d0d38046e63d2aee823e8f316711 /bin/sh -c test "${#SOURCE_COMMIT}" -eq 40     && case "$SOURCE_COMMIT" in *[!0-9a-f]*) exit 1 ;; *) exit 0 ;; esac # buildkit

HEALTHCHECK {Test:[CMD-SHELL python -c "import os,urllib.request,sys;   url='http://127.0.0.1:%s/health' % os.environ.get('PORT','8080');   sys.exit(0 if urllib.request.urlopen(url, timeout=4).status==200 else 1)" || exit 1] Interval:30s Timeout:5s StartPeriod:1m0s StartInterval:0s Retries:3}
